install.notes: requirements.txt pins pybullet==3.2.5, numpy==1.22.3 and gymnasium==0.28.1; the first use downloads the track scenes (racecar_gym/bullet/providers.py:90-96). The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install the upstream only to serve the real environment, which was not run.
